target.rule: close the remainder at the planned target

params.level: the lot target valid at each observation (tp, else e0 + tp_r x R)
params.fill: at the target level (resting order), modelled slippage

trailing.rule: trailing stop k x ATR from the running best since entry

params.fill: the observed mark that crossed the stop (never improved)

time_cap.rule: time cap: close at the first observation at/after entry + 48 bars

runner.rule: close the runner quantity at its activation

params.qty: open quantity right after the first partial take-profit

breakeven.rule: breakeven after costs: once +arm_r x R in favour, close when the net P&L after fees falls back to zero

params.level: net P&L after fees paid and the estimated exit fee = 0, with the lot state at each observation
params.fill: the observed mark that crossed it (never improved)

regime_exit.rule: regime exit: close at the first mark after a closed candle of the lot tf with the trend against the position

params.against: LONG: close < EMA200 and EMA20 < EMA50 (SHORT mirrored) on the last CLOSED candle of the lot tf
params.fill: the first mark sample at/after the candle-close decision

symbol.why: no closed-candle snapshot for this symbol / timeframe

btc.why: no closed-candle snapshot for this symbol / timeframe

entry.label: unknown
entry.rule: bear: symbol close < EMA200 (lot tf) AND BTC close < EMA200 (btc_basis); bull mirrored; else mixed / unknown
